A '''polarity check prong''' was a type of tool used to check magnetic and ionic polarity. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ellorrs Madak]] used one of these prongs to check the various onboard systems of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[YV-666 light freighter/Legends|Capital YV-class freighter]], the ''[[Millanti]]''.<ref name="Ellorrs Madak" />
